items.name: URefCounter<ActModelDatabase::ModelInfo>::AddReference
evidence: call order in ActModelDatabase::LoadModel (its only caller); copies the name, looks it up with a stricmp tree find, as PS2 AddReference

items.name: AICharacterEnemyGround::AICharacterEnemyGround
evidence: call order in AIElementController::WakeUp; AICharacter base constructor, copies a MATRIX4 argument, sets the class vtable (PS2 signature takes MATRIX4 &, int)

items.name: AIHelicopter::EnableTargetBeacon
evidence: last call in RegisterHelicopter, as on PS2; allocates a WTargetable when none; next to AIHelicopter::DisableTargetBeacon (0x318d0)

items.name: AIVehicle::SetPhysicsObject
evidence: second call in RegisterHelicopter, as on PS2: a one-field setter; its 6 callers are all AIVehicleController registration code
PS2 0x0013dfd0

items.name: AIVehicleController::ApproveAdditionalHelicopterSpawn
evidence: first call in RegisterHelicopter, as on PS2; counts helicopter slots against the controller's limit

items.name: AIVehicleController::RegisterHelicopter
evidence: body is PS2 RegisterHelicopter: ApproveAdditionalHelicopterSpawn, SetPhysicsObject, +0x134 = it, type 2, then EnableTargetBeacon(false) unless flagged. Called from WakeUp where PS2 calls the one-line wrapper RegisterSimHeli, which MSVC inlined

items.name: EAICommand::EAICommand
evidence: stores its seven arguments and vtable_EAICommand, field for field as PS2

items.name: AttributeValue::ComputeBytes
evidence: same switch on type codes -9..-1 with the same shifts as PS2; called by AttributeValue::Alloc

items.name: WTargetPicker::GetSelectedTarget
evidence: call order in SWeaponManager::FireWeapon; returns the current target if its selected flag is set, else null, as PS2

items.name: GHud::DrawFontAndShadow
evidence: call order in GHud::DrawTimer; LOCALE_Symbol when no text, draws at (x+1, y+1) in the shadow colour and then at (x, y), as PS2

items.name: EAGL::TextureRenderContext::TextureRenderContext
evidence: call order in EAGL::DeviceExtension::NewTextureRenderContext; two base/member constructors then stores the device argument, as PS2

items.name: SHAPE_type
evidence: call order in SHAPE_createat; a switch mapping format codes to shape types, as PS2 (the codes are platform formats)

items.name: FILE_loadat
evidence: called by UFileLoader::FileLoadAt as on PS2; packs (name, address, size, 1, 0) and runs FILESYS_atomic, as PS2 FILE_loadat

items.name: UFileLoader::FileLoadAt
evidence: call order in IniFiles::IniFiles; builds the path (LookupAbsolutePath inlined: / to \) then FILE_loadat, as PS2

items.name: EncryptDecrypt
evidence: call order in IniFiles::IniFiles; the same key table (0x359, 0xbb7, 0xeb7, ...) as PS2 and AUF EncryptDecrypt

items.name: AZoomObj::AZoomObj
